grade.primary_choice: Keep the data in Postgres, precompute top-N with BullMQ workers, and stay in TypeScript
grade.notes: This is a strong answer that matches the reference. It precomputes on a read replica, recomputes only for active users and on events, down-weights hubs, questions whether hop 3 is needed, says when to revisit a graph DB, and names the right things to measure, including p99 users with EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Its gaps are that it never says Prisma's model API can't express the traversal (so raw SQL or TypedSQL is needed), it only partly covers composite membership indexes, and it doesn't say to exclude the user themself.
